skills.name: /write-spec
skills.description: Dragon Scribe describes a game rule. AI turns it into a named spec and confirms it back in plain English.
skills.nestEvidence: Runs consistently, inputs and outputs defined
skills.flockEvidence: Reliable but chicken still triggers every run

skills.name: /lore-check
skills.description: Scans story notes for contradictions before a new scene is written.
skills.flockEvidence: Runs on schedule, one chicken owns it

skills.name: /sprite-gen
skills.description: Cannon Master describes a character. AI generates a sprite, commits to preview branch.
skills.flockEvidence: Reliable but needs trigger and review each run

skills.name: /bug-hunt
skills.description: Scans bug board, triages by severity, opens branch, writes failing test, posts fix for review.
skills.flockEvidence: Works reliably, human still reviews every run

skills.name: /standup
skills.description: Daily briefing — what each contributor committed to, what got done, blockers.
skills.nestEvidence: Cadence defined, same output every run

skills.name: Sound Check
skills.description: Validates new chiptune tracks against the game audio spec before wiring into a level.
skills.nestEvidence: Pain identified, process not yet defined
